doc:
# Modular Flow — Bulk Reconstruction

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “modular flow bulk reconstruction”).

claims.name: connection_between_modular_flow_generators
claims.statement: The connection between modular flow generators and SL(2, ℝ) boosts allows reconstruction of the dual bulk modular flow in two-sided AdS$_{2}$ black hole spacetime.

sources.title: Probing Evaporating Black Holes with Modular Flow in SYK

claims.name: bulk_geometry_reconstruction_boundary_mixed
claims.statement: Bulk geometry reconstruction from boundary mixed information is probed using modular Hamiltonian, modular flow, OPE blocks, quantum recovery channels such as Petz map, Uhlmann holonomy, and Wilson lines.

sources.title: Entanglement wedge reconstruction and correlation measures in mixed states: modular flows versus quantum recovery channels

claims.name: paper_argues_general_boundary_subregion
claims.statement: The paper argues that for a general boundary subregion, the relative entropy of nearby states equals the corresponding bulk relative entropy to leading order in the bulk gravitational coupling. It also identifies boundary modular flow with bulk modular flow in the entanglement wedge, linking this duality to entanglement wedge reconstruction.

sources.title: Relative entropy equals bulk relative entropy

claims.name: paper_reformulates_bulk_reconstruction_holography
claims.statement: The paper reformulates bulk reconstruction in holography using Berry phases of boundary CFT modular Hamiltonians, with state-space trajectories generated by Euclidean path-integral source insertions. Using a modular extrapolate dictionary and boundary-bulk modular flow equivalence, it shows that the expectation value of modular Berry curvature equals an entanglement-wedge bulk symplectic form, and also derives an information metric related to bulk canonical energy.

sources.title: Changing states in holography: From modular Berry curvature to the bulk symplectic form

claims.name: establish_systematic_expansion_modular_hamiltonian
claims.statement: We establish a systematic expansion of the modular Hamiltonian for excited states in conformal field theories, showing that quadratic-order contributions can be computed holographically via bulk canonical energy, with bulk fields defined by HKLL reconstruction contributing through the OPE block of the dual operator integrated along the vacuum modular flow.

sources.title: Modular Hamiltonians of excited states, OPE blocks and emergent bulk fields

claims.name: paper_shows_entanglement_wedge_reconstruction
claims.statement: The paper shows that entanglement wedge reconstruction in AdS/CFT can be carried out explicitly with the Petz recovery channel: for a spherical boundary region it reproduces AdS-Rindler HKLL reconstruction, and for a generic boundary subregion it yields the same boundary representation of a local bulk field as earlier modular-flow constructions.

sources.title: Explicit reconstruction of the entanglement wedge via the Petz map

claims.name: framework_relational_bulk_reconstruction_holography
claims.statement: A framework for relational bulk reconstruction in holography is developed to relate operator reconstructions between code subspaces both protected against boundary-region erasure. Modular-theory flow equations integrate to connect operators along smoothly-connected code families, with formulas exhibiting a striking resemblance to the infinite-time Connes cocycle flow.

sources.title: Relational bulk reconstruction from modular flow

claims.name: bulk_operators_between_outermost_extremal
claims.statement: Bulk operators between the outermost extremal surface and the asymptotic boundary admit simple classical-limit boundary reconstruction via HKLL construction with causal bulk propagation; the simple wedge dualizes to a coarse-grained CFT state whose modular Hamiltonian generates a local flow, interpreted as a holographic dual of black hole uniqueness.

sources.title: A World without Pythons would be so Simple

claims.name: review_synthesizes_progress_reconstructing_bulk
claims.statement: This review synthesizes progress on reconstructing bulk spacetime in holography from the dual field theory, including how these ideas reproduce the Hawking-radiation Page curve. It presents quantum error correction, recovery maps, modular-flow considerations, and tensor-network toy models as the framework for resolving operator-algebra tensions and organizing bulk reconstruction.

sources.title: Holographic spacetime, black holes and quantum error correcting codes: A review

claims.name: within_largen_ads_cftinspired_algebraic
claims.statement: Within large-N AdS/CFT-inspired algebraic QFT, the paper proposes asymptotically isometric quantum error-correcting codes as the natural non-isometric structure for gravity code subspaces, while the isometric description is recovered on fixed code states in the N to infinity limit. The framework introduces simple operators and causal-wedge nets, allows additive wedges without Haag duality (enabling non-trivial entanglement wedge reconstruction), and characterizes when complementary recovery exists through asymptotic bulk-boundary relative-entropy/modular-flow equality.
